subject: the template sandbox's browser mode resolves the host again, classifies EVERY answer, refuses on any non-loopback refusal or on an unavailable measurement, and pins Chromium to the literal it just vetted

mutants.label: R779-M1 the pin-time refusal fails OPEN -- a rebound private address is pinned instead of refused
R779-M2 only the FIRST resolved address is classified -- a rebind that adds a private sibling is admitted
mutants.old_regex: (?<=_canon, sockaddr in infos)(?=:\n        if family not in)

mutants.label: R779-M3 a pin-time DNS failure fails OPEN -- an unavailable measurement becomes permission to navigate
R779-M4 the pin is computed and then not plumbed to the browser launch
R779-M5 the rule maps the host to ITSELF, leaving Chromium to resolve the name again
R779-M6 the loopback exemption is dropped at the pin -- local selector authoring is refused
R779-M7 the IPv6 pin loses its brackets -- MAP host 2001:db8::1 instead of MAP host [2001:db8::1] (bd-lens-L1 U4)
mutants.old_regex: (?<=    literal = f"\[\{chosen\}\]" if )(?=":" in chosen else chosen\n)

mutants.label: R779-M8 the empty-host refusal is dropped -- an empty name is sent to the resolver and pinned (bd-lens-L1 U1)
R779-M9 a non-IP resolver answer is skipped instead of refused (bd-lens-L1 U2)
R779-M10 the no-usable-address guard is defeated -- the name is pinned to ITSELF (bd-lens-L1 U3)
mutants.old_regex: (?<=    chosen = None)(?=\n    for family, _stype, _proto, _canon, sockaddr in infos)
